correctness.rationale: The exact gcd identity follows from the established cyclic-normal-Sylow formula, the cyclic prime-power sum formula, and elementary coprimality and size bounds. The cyclic-by-cyclic corollary uses valid coprime direct-product decompositions, and an exact finite check reproduces the theorem on 4544 compatible parameter tuples.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. The closest prior ZM-group result imposes an exponent-size hypothesis, while targeted searches found no exact gcd formula or criterion stated in terms of prime-power action images or coprime image/kernel orders. Because the proof is short once the known semidirect formula is used, an implicit or differently phrased antecedent remains possible.

value.rationale: The result gives a uniform arithmetic obstruction across infinite metacyclic families, removes an exponent-size restriction on the prime-power-complement slice of a documented ZM-group result, and sharply identifies a smaller residual region of the longstanding nonabelian psi-divisibility problem.
